_note: Deep profiles for industry pages and ratings for the hub comparison grid. Ratings compare fitting out a unit, not stock. Facts about the units come only from BRIEF.md: single-phase power only, no ceiling heights, approval needed for every use.

unit-ideas-online-sellers.answer: Online selling is one of the easiest businesses to run from a 150 sq ft unit: standard sockets cover everything you need, the work is dry and low-risk, and a roller shutter makes stock in and parcels out quick.
unit-ideas-online-sellers.power_note: Lights, a laptop, a label printer and a scale
unit-ideas-online-sellers.cost_note: Shelving, a bench and a label printer
sources: Set up as a sole trader (GOV.UK)

E-commerce stock storage.answer: A 150 sq ft roller-shutter unit holds a small online shop's stock, a packing bench and a label printer, with a clear lane for couriers.
kit: Steel boltless shelving bays along both long walls
A packing bench about 1.8 m long with a roll holder for tape and paper
Thermal label printer and parcel scale on the Wi-Fi
Sack truck or folding platform trolley
Clear lidded crates and shelf labels
E-commerce stock storage.power_detail: Everything runs from standard 13 amp sockets on the single-phase supply: lights, a laptop, a label printer, a scale and a phone charger. You will rarely need more than one double socket at the bench.
E-commerce stock storage.safety: Boxed, dry stock is exactly what our units are set up for. There is no melting, heating or flammable processing, so the main things to manage are tidy aisles and not stacking cardboard against heaters. Tell us what you sell when you enquire, because every use needs our approval.
E-commerce stock storage.racking: Run shelving along both long walls and use the full height that your unit allows; we can tell you the height of the unit you are viewing. Heavy and fast-selling lines go at waist height, light bulky stock and spare packaging go on the top shelves, and slow sellers go low.
E-commerce stock storage.benches: Put the packing bench on lockable castors. Roll it to the middle when a big batch arrives for checking and labelling, then push it back against the wall by the door for everyday packing.
E-commerce stock storage.flow: Deliveries come in through the roller shutter and go straight onto a goods-in shelf for checking. Stock then moves to its labelled bay, orders are picked to the packing bench, and sealed parcels wait on a dispatch shelf next to the shutter for collection.
supplies: Boxes, mailing bags, paper fill and tape
Shelf labels and a simple stock list
E-commerce stock storage.cover: Ask a broker about stock cover for the goods in the unit, goods in transit if you deliver yourself, and public liability if customers or couriers come to the unit. Employers' liability is a legal requirement in most cases once you take on staff.

Vintage and reseller clothing.answer: Clothing rails, a photo corner and a steaming and packing table fit comfortably in 150 sq ft, and clothes are low-risk stock that is easy to organise.
kit: Heavy-duty double clothing rails on castors
Plain backdrop or wall with two LED softbox lights
Packing table with mailing bags and tissue
Vintage and reseller clothing.power_detail: A steamer, two LED lights and a laptop all run from standard sockets. Keep the steamer on its own socket rather than a long extension lead.
Vintage and reseller clothing.safety: Clothing is dry, low-risk stock. Keep bags and tissue in closed boxes and away from the steamer and any heater, and empty the steamer at the end of the day.
Vintage and reseller clothing.racking: Use rails for hung stock and wall shelving above them for folded items, shoes and bags in clear boxes. Label each rail by size, brand or platform so pickers find items fast.
Vintage and reseller clothing.benches: Wheeled rails let you change the room in minutes: push them together to open a photo area, or line them up by the door on dispatch day.
Vintage and reseller clothing.flow: Bags of new stock arrive at the door and go to a sorting rail. Items are cleaned and steamed, photographed in the corner, listed, and then hung on the stock rails. Sold items are picked, packed on the table and left on the dispatch shelf by the door.
supplies: Two LED lights and a backdrop
Vintage and reseller clothing.cover: Stock cover for clothing in the unit and public liability if buyers collect in person are worth discussing with a broker. Some platforms cover items in transit, so check what your selling platform includes.

Subscription box packing.answer: A 180 or 300 sq ft unit gives room for flat-packed boxes, product stock and a long assembly line for packing each month's boxes in batches.
kit: Long folding tables set up as an assembly line
Shelving for products by month or box type
Pallet of flat-packed boxes stored upright
Subscription box packing.power_detail: A label printer, a scale and a laptop on standard sockets cover the whole operation.
Subscription box packing.safety: Dry boxed items such as socks, books, stationery and packaged snacks are fine. Ask us before including anything flammable, such as aerosols. Packaged food needs extra thought: see our dry goods and botanicals guide.
Subscription box packing.racking: Stand flat-packed boxes upright on one side to save floor space. Put this month's products at waist height and next month's stock higher up, with a labelled bay for each box version.
Subscription box packing.benches: Folding or wheeled tables can be lined up as a packing line on dispatch week and folded away the rest of the month to leave room for deliveries.
Subscription box packing.flow: Products arrive at the shutter and are checked into their bays. On packing day, boxes are made up at the start of the line, filled station by station, sealed, labelled and stacked on the dispatch side nearest the door.
supplies: Tape guns, labels and a scale
Subscription box packing.cover: Stock and contents cover for products waiting to be packed, and products liability if you sell your own branded items. Talk to a broker about cover for goods in transit and for anyone who helps you on packing days.

Trading cards, comics and books.answer: The 160 sq ft security-door unit suits small, valuable paper stock: a grading desk, archive boxes on shelving and a separate packing area.
kit: Desk with a daylight task lamp and magnifier
Archive boxes and card storage boxes
Lockable steel cabinet for high-value items
Trading cards, comics and books.power_detail: A task lamp, laptop and printer use very little power on standard sockets.
Trading cards, comics and books.safety: Paper and card are low-risk stock. Keep them in closed boxes off the floor. The units are not climate-controlled, so ask us if your stock is sensitive to temperature or damp.
Trading cards, comics and books.racking: Shelving up the walls with archive boxes labelled by set, title or year. Keep the most valuable stock in a lockable cabinet rather than on open shelves.
Trading cards, comics and books.benches: A wheeled cart holds the stock you are currently sorting, so the desk stays clear and the cart can be locked away at the end of the day.
Trading cards, comics and books.flow: Stock arrives through the security door to a sorting table, is graded and photographed at the desk, then filed into labelled boxes. Sold items are packed at a separate table so stock and packaging never mix.
Trading cards, comics and books.cover: High-value stock is the main risk, so ask a broker about stock cover with the right limits for individual items, and cover for items in transit. Public liability matters if buyers come to the unit.

Board game and book publishing fulfilmen.answer: A 180 or 300 sq ft unit can hold a small publisher's print run on shelving and pallets, with a packing station for orders and pre-orders.
kit: Pallet truck if stock arrives on pallets
Packing bench with scale and label printer
Book mailers and boxes in several sizes
Board game and book publishing fulfilmen.power_detail: Standard sockets cover label printing, a scale and a laptop.
Board game and book publishing fulfilmen.safety: Printed books, games and card are low-risk. Keep cartons off the floor and keep the route from the shutter clear when a delivery is due.
Board game and book publishing fulfilmen.racking: Long-span shelving with full cartons on the lower levels and open cartons at waist height for picking. Plan the space before a print run lands so a pallet has somewhere to go.
Board game and book publishing fulfilmen.benches: A wheeled packing bench can be moved beside the stock bay that is selling fastest during a launch or crowdfunding fulfilment.
Board game and book publishing fulfilmen.flow: Pallets or cartons come in through the roller shutter, are counted and shelved, then picked to the packing bench. Packed orders are stacked by courier on the dispatch side by the door.
Board game and book publishing fulfilmen.cover: Stock cover for the print run and products liability for your own titles are worth discussing with a broker, along with cover for goods in transit.

Packaging supplies distribution.answer: Light, bulky packaging stock suits a 180 or 300 sq ft roller-shutter unit, with heavy items low and light stock high on shelving.
kit: Order desk with a laptop and printer
Packaging supplies distribution.power_detail: A laptop and printer on standard sockets is all most distributors need.
Packaging supplies distribution.safety: Paper and card are fine. Ask us before storing large quantities of plastic film or foam, so we can check it suits the building.
Packaging supplies distribution.racking: Bulky but light stock, such as rolls of paper and flat boxes, goes high; heavy items such as tape cartons stay low. Keep each product in its own labelled bay.
Packaging supplies distribution.benches: A wheeled order desk can sit by the door during delivery runs and move back when stock arrives.
Packaging supplies distribution.flow: Stock comes in through the shutter to its bay. Orders are picked into the van loading area by the door and loaded straight from there.
supplies: Stock labels and a price list
Packaging supplies distribution.cover: Ask a broker about stock cover, goods in transit for deliveries and public liability for visits to customers' premises.

unit-ideas-textiles-leather.answer: Sewing, embroidery and leatherwork fit well in a 150 to 180 sq ft unit: most machines run on standard single-phase sockets, and fabric and leather are low-risk materials with no melting or heating involved.
unit-ideas-textiles-leather.power_note: Several machines and an iron on standard sockets
unit-ideas-textiles-leather.layout_note: Cutting table, machine bench and rails

Tailoring and alterations.answer: One or two sewing machines, an overlocker, a cutting table and rails for customers' garments fit in a 150 or 160 sq ft unit.
kit: Industrial lockstitch sewing machine with a servo motor
Steam iron or steam generator on a heat-proof stand
Rails for jobs in progress and finished work
Tailoring and alterations.power_detail: Industrial machines with servo motors run on standard single-phase sockets and draw little power. A steam generator iron draws the most, so give it its own socket. There is no three-phase power in the units.
Tailoring and alterations.safety: Fabric and thread are low-risk materials. Use the iron on a heat-proof stand and switch it off at the end of the day. Every business use needs our approval first.
Tailoring and alterations.racking: Shelving above the machines for thread, zips and trims in labelled boxes. Hang customers' garments on rails tagged with name and collection date.
Tailoring and alterations.benches: Put the cutting table on lockable castors so it can be pushed against the wall to make room for a fitting, then rolled back out for cutting.
Tailoring and alterations.flow: Customers hand over garments at the door, which are tagged and hung on the in-progress rail. Work moves to the cutting table, then to the machines and the pressing station, and finished items go to a collection rail near the door.
supplies: Basic stock of thread and zips
Tailoring and alterations.cover: Customers' garments in your care are the key risk, so ask a broker about goods in trust cover, plus public liability for customers at fittings and contents cover for your machines.

Embroidery and personalisation.answer: Single-head and small multi-head embroidery machines that run on a standard socket, plus blank stock on shelving, fit in a 150 or 180 sq ft unit.
kit: Single-head or small multi-head commercial embroidery machine on its stand
Heat press for transfers, if we approve it
Embroidery and personalisation.power_detail: Check that any machine you buy runs on single-phase power from a normal socket, because there is no three-phase supply. A heat press draws a lot of power, so give it its own socket and ask us about it first.
Embroidery and personalisation.safety: Stitching onto fabric is dry, mechanical work. A heat press heats transfers rather than melting combustible materials, but it is still a heat source, so tell us about it when you enquire.
Embroidery and personalisation.racking: Blank garments on shelving by size and colour, thread on a wall rack above the machine, and finished orders bagged and labelled on a separate shelf.
Embroidery and personalisation.benches: A wheeled hooping and folding table can sit beside the machine during a run and be moved to the door for bagging and dispatch.
Embroidery and personalisation.flow: Blank stock comes in through the shutter to its shelf. Garments are hooped, embroidered, trimmed and folded, then bagged and labelled on the dispatch shelf by the door.
Embroidery and personalisation.cover: Ask a broker about contents cover for the machine, which is usually the biggest single cost, goods in trust for customers' own garments, and products liability for items you sell.

Leather goods workshop.answer: Cutting, hand-stitching and finishing small leather goods needs a big flat surface and good lighting, which a 150 or 160 sq ft unit gives you.
kit: Large self-healing cutting mat on a sturdy table
Hide rack for flat or rolled hides
Leather goods workshop.power_detail: Most leatherwork is by hand. Lighting and an optional leather sewing machine run on standard sockets.
Leather goods workshop.safety: Dry hides and hand tools are fine. Ask us before using solvent-based dyes or glues in any quantity, and keep any you do use in small, closed containers.
Leather goods workshop.racking: Store hides flat on deep shelves or rolled on a wall rack, with hardware such as buckles and rivets in labelled drawers.
Leather goods workshop.benches: A wheeled finishing bench can be pulled next to the cutting table when you batch-produce, then pushed aside when you need the floor for large hides.
Leather goods workshop.flow: Hides come in and go to the rack. Pieces are cut on the big table, stitched at the bench, finished and checked, then packed for orders or market stock.
Leather goods workshop.cover: Products liability for goods you sell, contents cover for tools and stock, and public liability if customers visit are the covers to raise with a broker.

Curtains, blinds and soft furnishings.answer: Made-to-measure curtains need the longest table you can fit, so a 180 or 300 sq ft roller-shutter unit is the best fit.
Curtains, blinds and soft furnishings.power_detail: Sewing machines and an iron run on standard sockets. Spread heavy-draw items such as irons across different sockets.
Curtains, blinds and soft furnishings.safety: Fabric is low-risk. Keep it away from heaters and switch the iron off at the end of the day.
Curtains, blinds and soft furnishings.racking: Fabric rolls on a wall rack, linings and tapes on shelving, finished orders hung or boxed near the door.
Curtains, blinds and soft furnishings.benches: Machines on wheeled benches can be pushed to the wall when the full length of the table is needed for measuring and cutting.
Curtains, blinds and soft furnishings.flow: Rolls arrive through the shutter to the rack. Fabric is measured and cut on the long table, sewn at the machines, pressed, then folded or hung ready for fitting.
Curtains, blinds and soft furnishings.cover: Ask a broker about public liability for fitting in customers' homes, goods in trust for customers' fabric and contents cover for machines.

Costume and dancewear making.answer: Costume makers need rails, a sewing area and space for fittings, which fit in a 150 or 160 sq ft unit.
kit: Overlocker or coverstitch machine for stretch fabrics
Costume and dancewear making.power_detail: Machines and an iron run on standard sockets.
Costume and dancewear making.safety: Fabric, trims and sequins are low-risk. Hot-fix stone applicators are small heat tools, so tell us if you plan to use them.
Costume and dancewear making.racking: Rails for finished costumes, shelving above for fabric and trims in labelled boxes by colour.
Costume and dancewear making.benches: Wheeled rails can be moved to open a fitting area with the mirror when dancers or performers visit.
Costume and dancewear making.flow: Fabric comes in to shelving, is cut and sewn, decorated at the bench, fitted, and hung on the finished rail for collection.
Costume and dancewear making.cover: Public liability for fittings, goods in trust for performers' costumes and contents cover for machines are worth discussing with a broker.

unit-ideas-makers-studios.answer: Most makers' studios suit a 150 to 180 sq ft unit: framing, hand woodwork, jewellery, sign-making, paper goods and photography all work with dry materials and standard single-phase sockets.
unit-ideas-makers-studios.power_note: Benchtop machines and extraction on standard sockets
unit-ideas-makers-studios.layout_note: Zones for making, finishing and packing

Picture framing.answer: A framing workshop fits in a 150 or 180 sq ft unit with upright racks for mouldings, board and glass along one wall.
kit: Vertical racks for moulding lengths, board and glass
Picture framing.power_detail: Most framing tools are manual or pneumatic. A mitre saw and a small compressor run on standard sockets.
Picture framing.safety: Wood, board and glass are low-risk materials. Store glass upright in a rack, never flat on the floor.
Picture framing.racking: Moulding lengths stand upright in a wall rack, board and glass in slotted racks, and finished frames are wrapped and stacked by the door.
Picture framing.benches: A wheeled assembly bench can be pulled out for large frames and pushed back against the wall for everyday work.
Picture framing.flow: Mouldings and board come in through the shutter to their racks. Each job is cut, mounted, glazed and assembled, then wrapped and placed by the door for collection.
Picture framing.cover: Customers' artwork in your care makes goods in trust cover important. Ask a broker about that, contents cover for tools, and public liability for visitors.

Small-scale woodworking.answer: Hand tools and benchtop machines with dust extraction fit in a 180 or 300 sq ft roller-shutter unit, and wood is a low-risk material.
kit: Mitre saw on a mobile stand
Small-scale woodworking.power_detail: Benchtop machines run on single-phase power, which is what the units have. Choose single-phase machines and avoid running two motors at once on the same socket. There is no three-phase power.
Small-scale woodworking.safety: Wood is low-risk to store and work. Fine dust is the main issue, so use extraction and clear offcuts daily. HSE has guidance on wood dust. Ask us before using solvent-based finishes in any quantity.
Small-scale woodworking.racking: Timber on a wall rack with long lengths low and offcuts in a bin, clamps on a wall rail, and hand tools on a pegboard above the bench.
Small-scale woodworking.benches: Put benchtop machines on wheeled stands with locking castors so they can be rolled out to use and pushed back to keep the floor clear.
Small-scale woodworking.flow: Timber comes in through the shutter to the rack, is cut at the machines, assembled at the bench, sanded with extraction running, then finished and packed near the door.
Small-scale woodworking.cover: Ask a broker about contents cover for tools and machines, products liability for items you sell, and public liability if customers visit.

Jewellery bench.answer: The 160 sq ft security-door unit suits a jeweller's bench with secure storage for metals and stones.
Jewellery bench.power_detail: Bench motors, a polisher and an ultrasonic cleaner all run on standard sockets.
Jewellery bench.safety: Metal hand-work is low-risk. Ask us before using an open-flame torch or a casting kiln, because these need our approval.
Jewellery bench.racking: Small labelled drawers for findings and stones, tools on a rack above the bench, and stock and customers' items in the lockable cabinet.
Jewellery bench.benches: Keep polishing on a separate wheeled stand so dust stays away from the main bench.
Jewellery bench.flow: Repairs are booked in through the door and logged, worked at the bench, polished and cleaned, then stored in the cabinet until collection.
Jewellery bench.cover: Customers' jewellery is high value, so goods in trust cover with the right limits is the main cover to discuss with a broker, along with stock and contents cover.

Vinyl signs and decals.answer: A vinyl plotter, weeding table and laminator fit in a 150 or 180 sq ft unit, and plotting and weeding involve no melting.
Vinyl signs and decals.power_detail: A plotter, a computer and a cold laminator use little power on standard sockets.
Vinyl signs and decals.safety: Vinyl sheet is fine to store and cut. Tell us before adding a printer that uses solvent inks.
Vinyl signs and decals.racking: Vinyl rolls on a wall rack by colour, application tape and transfer film on shelving, and finished signs flat on a shelf.
Vinyl signs and decals.benches: A wheeled application table can be rolled to the shutter for large signs and back against the wall for small decals.
Vinyl signs and decals.flow: Rolls come in to the rack. Designs are cut on the plotter, weeded and taped at the table, then packed or loaded for fitting.
Vinyl signs and decals.cover: Ask a broker about public liability for fitting signs on site, products liability and contents cover for the plotter.

Paper goods and stationery.answer: Greeting cards, invitations, prints and notebooks need a printer, a guillotine and dry, tidy storage, all of which fit easily in a 150 or 160 sq ft unit.
kit: Desktop or small production digital printer
Heavy-duty stack guillotine or rotary trimmer
Creasing and scoring board or machine
Flat file drawers or boxes for paper stock
Packing table with cello bags and backing boards
Paper goods and stationery.power_detail: A digital printer, laptop and task lighting run on standard 13 amp sockets. A production printer is the biggest draw, so give it its own socket.
Paper goods and stationery.safety: Paper and card are low-risk stock and there is no heating or melting involved. Keep stock in closed boxes off the floor and keep offcuts in a lidded bin that you empty each week.
Paper goods and stationery.racking: Paper stock flat in boxes or drawers on the lower shelves, where it is heavy, and finished designs boxed and labelled by range on the upper shelves. Use the height of the walls rather than stacking boxes on the floor.
Paper goods and stationery.benches: A wheeled table can be the cutting station during a print run and the packing station on order day. Lock the castors while you use the guillotine.
Paper goods and stationery.flow: Paper and envelopes come in through the door to the stock shelves, go to the printer, then to cutting and folding, then to the packing table. Finished orders and wholesale boxes wait on a dispatch shelf by the door.
Paper goods and stationery.cover: Ask a broker about stock cover, contents cover for the printer and cutting kit, and products liability if you sell your own designs to shops.

Product photography studio.answer: A backdrop, two or three lights and a shooting table fit in a 150 or 180 sq ft unit, and the windowless ground floor gives you complete control of the light.
kit: Backdrop stand with paper rolls in white, grey and black
Two or three LED lights with softboxes
Editing desk with a calibrated monitor
Product photography studio.power_detail: LED studio lights draw far less than older tungsten lights, so a full setup with a computer runs from standard sockets.
Product photography studio.safety: Camera kit, props and backdrops are low-risk. Tape cables down or run them along the walls so nobody trips when moving products around.
Product photography studio.racking: Backdrop rolls on a wall rack, props on shelving sorted by colour or theme, and clients' products on their own labelled shelf near the door, separate from your props.
Product photography studio.benches: Put lights and the shooting table on wheels so you can reset the set in a minute between products, or clear the floor for a larger item.
Product photography studio.flow: Clients' products come in through the door and are logged on their shelf. Each product goes to the set, is shot, then edited at the desk while it goes back to its shelf to be returned.
Product photography studio.cover: Goods in trust cover for clients' products, contents cover for camera kit and public liability for clients who visit are the main covers to ask a broker about.

Podcast and voiceover booth.answer: The 160 sq ft security-door unit makes a quiet, private recording room with space for a host and two guests.
kit: Acoustic foam or mineral wool panels for walls and ceiling corners
Ring light and camera if you film episodes
Podcast and voiceover booth.power_detail: Audio kit, a computer and LED video lights run on standard sockets.
Podcast and voiceover booth.safety: Recording kit is low-risk. Fix acoustic panels securely and keep cables tidy.
Podcast and voiceover booth.racking: Shelving for spare mics, cables and stands in labelled boxes, kept on the wall behind the camera.
Podcast and voiceover booth.benches: A wheeled desk can switch between a solo voiceover position facing the wall and a round-table podcast setup.
Podcast and voiceover booth.flow: Guests come in through the security door to a seat at the desk. Recordings go straight to the computer and to cloud storage over the Wi-Fi.
Podcast and voiceover booth.cover: Contents cover for audio and video kit and public liability for guests are the covers to discuss with a broker.

unit-ideas-tech-repair.answer: Repair benches are a good fit for a 150 or 160 sq ft unit: repair and assembly are dry, mechanical jobs, the tools run on standard single-phase sockets, and the security-door unit keeps customers' devices safe overnight.
unit-ideas-tech-repair.power_note: Soldering stations, chargers and test kit
unit-ideas-tech-repair.layout_note: Clean bench, secure storage and booking-in area
unit-ideas-tech-repair.cost_note: Specialist bench tools and parts stock

Phone, tablet and laptop repair.answer: An anti-static repair bench, micro-soldering kit and a lockable cabinet for customers' devices fit in a 160 sq ft security-door unit.
kit: ESD anti-static bench mat and wrist strap
Phone, tablet and laptop repair.power_detail: Soldering and rework stations, a microscope light and chargers run on standard sockets. Use a surge-protected power strip at the bench.
Phone, tablet and laptop repair.safety: Repair is dry, mechanical work. Solder melts metal, not combustible materials, but use a fume extractor. Store replacement batteries in their packaging and do not keep damaged or swollen batteries in the unit.
Phone, tablet and laptop repair.racking: Parts in labelled drawer cabinets above the bench, devices awaiting repair in tagged trays, and finished repairs in the lockable cabinet.
Phone, tablet and laptop repair.benches: A wheeled booking-in desk by the door keeps customers away from the repair bench.
Phone, tablet and laptop repair.flow: Customers book devices in at the door desk, devices are tagged and stored, repaired at the bench, tested, and locked away until collection.
Phone, tablet and laptop repair.cover: Customers' devices are the main risk, so ask a broker about goods in trust cover. Public liability for customers and contents cover for your kit are also worth raising. If you handle data, ICO registration may apply.

PC building and IT services.answer: An assembly bench, a test bench and parts shelving fit in a 150 or 180 sq ft unit, with Wi-Fi for updates and network testing.
kit: Assembly bench with ESD mat and wrist strap
Test bench with spare monitor, keyboard and PSU tester
Cable management supplies and cable ties
PC building and IT services.power_detail: Gaming PCs under stress tests draw more than most kit, so test one machine per socket and use surge-protected strips. Everything runs on standard single-phase sockets.
PC building and IT services.safety: Hardware assembly and configuration are dry, low-risk jobs. Keep packaging flattened and stored rather than piled by the bench.
PC building and IT services.racking: Parts on labelled shelving by type: cases low, boards and cards in the middle, small parts in drawers. Boxed, finished builds sit on a shelf by the door.
PC building and IT services.benches: Put the test bench on wheels so a machine can be rolled aside for an overnight burn-in test while you build the next one.
PC building and IT services.flow: Parts arrive at the door, are checked against the order and shelved. Builds are assembled, moved to the test bench, imaged and updated over the Wi-Fi, then boxed for delivery or collection.
PC building and IT services.cover: If you give IT advice or set up networks, ask a broker about professional indemnity. Stock cover, goods in trust for customers' machines and public liability are also worth raising.

Drone assembly and repair.answer: Building and repairing camera and racing drones needs a clean bench, parts drawers and careful battery handling, which fits in a 150 or 160 sq ft unit.
kit: Assembly bench with good task lighting
Temperature-controlled soldering station and fume extractor
Parts drawer cabinets for motors, ESCs and props
LiPo fire-safe charging bags or a metal battery box
Drone assembly and repair.power_detail: Chargers, a soldering station and a laptop for flight controller setup run on standard sockets.
Drone assembly and repair.safety: Assembly and wiring are mechanical work, but lithium polymer batteries need care. Charge them in fire-safe bags, only while you are in the unit, and never store damaged or puffed batteries. Ask us about how many batteries you plan to keep.
Drone assembly and repair.racking: Parts in labelled drawer cabinets above the bench, frames and finished drones in boxes on shelving, and batteries in their fire-safe box on a low shelf away from card and paper.
Drone assembly and repair.benches: A wheeled test cart keeps powered-up testing away from the stock and the main bench.
Drone assembly and repair.flow: Parts or customers' drones come in through the door, are logged, repaired or built at the bench, configured on the laptop, then boxed for collection or testing outdoors.
Drone assembly and repair.cover: Ask a broker about goods in trust for customers' drones, products liability for drones you build and sell, and contents cover for tools. Flying itself has separate CAA rules.

Bicycle servicing.answer: A workstand, a tool wall and wall hooks for bikes fit in a 150 or 180 sq ft roller-shutter unit.
kit: Wall hooks or vertical bike racks
Bicycle servicing.power_detail: Lighting and a small compressor run on standard sockets. Push-bike servicing uses mostly hand tools.
Bicycle servicing.safety: Mechanical repairs are low-risk. Use water-based degreasers rather than solvents, and ask us before working on or storing e-bike batteries.
Bicycle servicing.racking: Hang bikes waiting for repair or collection on wall hooks to keep the floor clear, with tyres, tubes and parts on shelving.
Bicycle servicing.benches: A wheeled parts and tool cart moves between the workstand and the truing stand.
Bicycle servicing.flow: Bikes come in through the shutter and are tagged, serviced on the stand, test-ridden outside, then hung by the door ready to collect.
supplies: Consumables: cables, chains, brake pads, tubes
Bicycle servicing.cover: Goods in trust cover for customers' bikes, public liability and contents cover for tools are the covers to raise with a broker.

Locksmith base and key cutting.answer: The 160 sq ft security-door unit makes a secure base for cutting keys, repairing cylinders and keeping lock stock.
kit: Key cutting machine on a solid bench
Labelled drawer cabinets for blanks and locks
Cylinder repair bench and pinning kit
Locksmith base and key cutting.power_detail: Key cutting machines run on standard sockets.
Locksmith base and key cutting.safety: Mechanical work is low-risk. Keep swarf swept up and stock in drawers.
Locksmith base and key cutting.racking: Key blanks in labelled drawers by profile, locks on shelving by type, and van restock boxes by the door.
Locksmith base and key cutting.benches: A wheeled restock trolley is loaded overnight and rolled straight to the van in the morning.
Locksmith base and key cutting.flow: Stock arrives through the door to its drawers, keys and cylinders are prepared at the bench, and the van is restocked from the trolley.
Locksmith base and key cutting.cover: Public liability for work at customers' properties and tools and stock cover are the main covers to discuss with a broker.

Tool and knife sharpening.answer: A sharpening station on a solid bench fits in a 150 sq ft unit, with a clean area for finished work.
Tool and knife sharpening.power_detail: Water-cooled sharpeners run on standard sockets.
Tool and knife sharpening.safety: Keep the sharpening area clear of card and paper. Ask us about any dry grinder that throws sparks before you install it.
Tool and knife sharpening.racking: Customers' items in tagged trays on shelving, stones and spares above the bench.
Tool and knife sharpening.benches: A wheeled tray trolley carries finished work away from the sharpening area.
Tool and knife sharpening.flow: Items are logged in at the door, sharpened, checked and returned from the finished shelf.
Tool and knife sharpening.cover: Goods in trust for customers' tools and public liability are worth discussing with a broker.

unit-ideas-trades-storage.answer: A 150 or 180 sq ft roller-shutter unit works as a secure lock-up for tools, materials and stock: storage needs only lighting and a socket, and tools, timber and boxed goods are low-risk.
unit-ideas-trades-storage.layout_note: Shelving with a clear loading lane

Tradesperson tool and materials store.answer: Electricians, plumbers, joiners and decorators can keep tools, fittings and materials in a 150 or 180 sq ft unit, so the van is no longer the warehouse.
kit: Battery charging station on a shelf
Tradesperson tool and materials store.power_detail: Lights and battery chargers run on standard sockets. Charge battery packs while you are in the unit.
Tradesperson tool and materials store.safety: Tools, timber, fixings and water-based paints are low-risk. Ask us before storing solvent-based paints, fuel or gas cylinders.
Tradesperson tool and materials store.racking: Heavy materials low, fittings in labelled bins at eye level, long lengths on a wall rack, and hand tools on the tool wall.
Tradesperson tool and materials store.benches: A wheeled prep bench can be pulled out for cutting and pushed back to leave room for a delivery.
Tradesperson tool and materials store.flow: Materials come in through the shutter to their shelves. Each job is picked into crates the night before and staged by the door for a fast load in the morning.
Tradesperson tool and materials store.cover: Ask a broker about tools cover, stock cover for materials in the unit, and public liability for your work on site. Employers' liability is a legal requirement in most cases once you take on staff.

Event and wedding prop storage.answer: Backdrops, arches, linen and centrepieces need height and dry space, which a 180 or 300 sq ft roller-shutter unit gives you.
kit: Upright rack for backdrops and arches
Event and wedding prop storage.power_detail: Lights and battery chargers for LED decorations run on standard sockets.
Event and wedding prop storage.safety: Props, fabric and wood are low-risk. Keep linen in lidded crates to stay clean and dry.
Event and wedding prop storage.racking: Tall items stand against the back wall, linen in labelled crates on shelving, and small decorations in clear boxes by theme.
Event and wedding prop storage.benches: A wheeled staging table by the shutter is where each event is packed into crates.
Event and wedding prop storage.flow: Props come back through the shutter, are checked and cleaned, returned to shelves, then picked to the staging table for the next event.
Event and wedding prop storage.cover: Contents cover for props and public liability for setting up at venues are worth discussing with a broker.

Home staging furniture.answer: Accent furniture, rugs, lamps, cushions and art for staging homes fit in a 180 or 300 sq ft roller-shutter unit, kept clean and off the floor.
kit: Fitted furniture covers and moving blankets
Low pallets or platforms to keep furniture off the floor
Slotted upright rack for framed art and mirrors
Shelving for lamps, cushions and accessories in lidded boxes
Furniture dollies and a platform trolley
Home staging furniture.power_detail: Lighting is all you need for storage. A socket is handy for testing lamps before they go out.
Home staging furniture.safety: Furniture and soft furnishings are low-risk. Keep fabric items covered and in lidded boxes so they stay clean between properties.
Home staging furniture.racking: Sofas and tables on pallets along the back wall, rugs rolled on the rack, art upright in slots, and accessories boxed by room style (living room, bedroom, dining) on shelving.
Home staging furniture.benches: Furniture dollies make each piece mobile, so you can pull out a full room set by the shutter in a few minutes.
Home staging furniture.flow: Returning pieces come in through the shutter, are checked and cleaned, covered and shelved by style. For the next property, a room set is pulled forward to the loading area by the door.
Home staging furniture.cover: Ask a broker about contents cover for your staging stock and public liability for work in clients' homes.

Property maintenance supplies.answer: Landlords and property managers can keep spare fittings, flooring, fixings and tools in a 150 or 180 sq ft unit, organised by property or job type.
kit: Shelving labelled by property or job type
Small parts bins for fixings, plumbing and electrical spares
Rack for flooring offcuts and boards
Wall board with the stock list
Property maintenance supplies.power_detail: Lighting and battery tool chargers on standard sockets.
Property maintenance supplies.safety: Spares, fixings and flooring are low-risk. Keep cleaning products to everyday quantities, and ask us before storing anything flammable.
Property maintenance supplies.racking: Heavy items such as flooring and tiles low, small parts in labelled bins at eye level, and turnover kits (bulbs, smoke alarm batteries, seals) in boxes by property.
Property maintenance supplies.benches: A small wheeled bench can be rolled out for a quick repair or assembly and parked against the wall.
Property maintenance supplies.flow: Supplies come in through the shutter to their shelves. Each job is picked into a crate from the stock list and loaded from the door.
Property maintenance supplies.cover: Contents cover for supplies and tools and public liability for work at properties are the main covers to raise with a broker.

Cleaning company equipment.answer: Vacuums, floor machines, mops and everyday supplies for a commercial or domestic cleaning business fit in a 150 or 160 sq ft unit.
kit: Floor space along one wall for machines
Charging station for cordless vacuums and machines
Wall hooks for mops and poles
Cleaning company equipment.power_detail: Chargers for cordless kit run on standard sockets. Spread chargers across sockets rather than chaining extension leads.
Cleaning company equipment.safety: Keep cleaning chemicals to everyday quantities in their original containers. Water for refilling is in the shared facilities.
Cleaning company equipment.racking: Consumables such as cloths, bags and paper on shelving, chemicals on a low shelf in their original containers, and poles and mops on wall hooks.
Cleaning company equipment.benches: Each team's supply caddy or trolley is restocked at the end of the day and stands ready by the door.
Cleaning company equipment.flow: Teams return kit through the door, machines go on charge, caddies are restocked from the shelves, and everything is staged by the door for the morning.
Cleaning company equipment.cover: Public liability for work at clients' premises, contents cover for machines and employers' liability once you have staff are the covers to raise with a broker.

Business archives and stock overflow.answer: Overflow stock, seasonal stock or boxed records fit in a 150 or 160 sq ft unit, indexed so you can find things quickly.
kit: Archive boxes in one standard size
Box labels and a printed or online index
Step stool for the top shelves
Business archives and stock overflow.safety: Paper and boxed stock are low-risk. The units are not climate-controlled, so ask us if anything is sensitive to temperature or damp. Records with personal data should be stored securely and kept only as long as you need them.
Business archives and stock overflow.racking: Archive boxes on shelving by year or category, with the most-used boxes at waist height and old records on the top shelves.
Business archives and stock overflow.benches: A small wheeled desk lets you work through a box in the unit without carrying it home.
Business archives and stock overflow.flow: Boxes come in through the door, are numbered and logged on the index, then shelved. Retrieval is by box number.
Business archives and stock overflow.cover: Contents cover for stock in the unit is the main cover to discuss with a broker.

unit-ideas-dry-goods-botanicals.answer: Dry food packing and botanicals can work in a small unit if no heating or cooking is involved and the council accepts your setup: tea blending, spice packing, pre-roasted coffee bags, hampers and dried flowers, all with our approval first.
unit-ideas-dry-goods-botanicals.power_note: Scales, a heat sealer and a label printer
unit-ideas-dry-goods-botanicals.layout_note: Separate clean packing area for food
sources: Safer food, better business (FSA on GOV.UK)
Allergen guidance for food businesses (FSA on GOV.UK)
Allergen labelling for PPDS food (FSA on GOV.UK)

Loose-leaf tea blending and packing.answer: Blending and packing loose-leaf tea and herbal infusions is dry work that fits in a 150 or 160 sq ft unit, once you have registered as a food business and we have approved the use.
kit: Food-grade airtight tubs or bins for each tea
Stainless steel blending bowls and scoops
Precision digital scale (0.1 g) and a larger bench scale
Impulse bag sealer for foil or kraft pouches
Label printer for ingredients and allergen labels
Easy-clean stainless or laminate packing table
Loose-leaf tea blending and packing.power_detail: Scales, a label printer and an impulse sealer run on standard sockets. An impulse sealer only heats briefly to close a bag; it does not cook or melt anything in bulk, but mention it when you ask us for approval.
Loose-leaf tea blending and packing.safety: Tea and dried herbs are dry goods with no cooking or heating. Food hygiene rules still apply: you need to register with Blackpool Council at least 28 days before trading, keep a food safety plan such as Safer Food, Better Business, and talk to the council about handwashing and cleaning facilities. Water is in the shared facilities, so ask us what arrangements suit your setup before you commit.
Loose-leaf tea blending and packing.racking: Sealed tubs of each tea on shelving off the floor, sorted so ingredients with allergens sit on their own shelf. Packaging and finished stock go on separate shelves from open ingredients.
Loose-leaf tea blending and packing.benches: Keep one fixed clean table for open food. A wheeled table next to it handles labelling, boxing and dispatch, so packaging work never happens on the food surface.
Loose-leaf tea blending and packing.flow: Ingredients come in through the door, are checked against the delivery note and stored in sealed tubs. Blends are weighed and mixed on the clean table, packed and sealed, labelled at the wheeled table, then boxed on a dispatch shelf by the door.
Loose-leaf tea blending and packing.cover: Products liability is important when people consume what you sell. Ask a broker about that, stock cover and public liability. Employers' liability is a legal requirement in most cases once you take on staff.

Spice and dried herb blending.answer: Spice blends and dried herbs can be weighed and packed in a 150 or 180 sq ft unit, with careful dust control and allergen labelling.
kit: Stainless steel blending bowls and scoops
Grinder for small batches (ask us first)
Jars or pouches and an impulse sealer
Spice and dried herb blending.power_detail: Scales, a small grinder and a sealer run on standard sockets.
Spice and dried herb blending.safety: No heating or cooking is involved. Some spice ingredients are among the 14 major allergens, including celery, mustard and sesame, so keep them separate and label them clearly. Fine powders create dust, so work in small batches and clean down after each one. Register with the council and ask us before you start.
Spice and dried herb blending.racking: Sealed containers on shelving by ingredient, with allergen ingredients kept on their own shelf. Finished jars boxed on a separate rack.
Spice and dried herb blending.benches: A fixed clean table for open spices and a wheeled labelling and packing table that moves next to it for each batch.
Spice and dried herb blending.flow: Ingredients come in, are logged and stored. Each batch is weighed, blended, filled and sealed on the clean table, labelled on the wheeled table, then stored for dispatch near the door.
Spice and dried herb blending.cover: Products liability, stock cover and public liability are the covers to raise with a broker.

Pre-roasted coffee packing.answer: Bagging and selling coffee that is already roasted can work in a 150 or 160 sq ft unit. Roasting itself is not allowed, because it involves heat.
kit: Valve bags and an impulse sealer
Pre-roasted coffee packing.power_detail: A commercial grinder, scales and a sealer run on standard sockets.
Pre-roasted coffee packing.safety: Our units do not allow roasting or any cooking, so buy your coffee already roasted from a roaster. Packing beans and grinding are dry processes. You still need to register as a food business and keep food safety records.
Pre-roasted coffee packing.racking: Sealed bins of beans on shelving off the floor, empty bags and labels on a separate shelf, and finished bags boxed by blend.
Pre-roasted coffee packing.benches: A wheeled grinder stand lets you move between whole-bean and ground orders without crossing the packing area.
Pre-roasted coffee packing.flow: Roasted beans arrive in sealed bags, go to bins, are weighed and bagged (or ground and bagged), sealed, labelled and placed on the dispatch shelf by the door.
Pre-roasted coffee packing.cover: Products liability, stock cover and public liability are the covers to discuss with a broker.

Hampers and pre-packed gift boxes.answer: Hampers made from pre-packed food, sweets and gifts, including Blackpool rock, fit in a 180 or 300 sq ft unit with room for seasonal stock.
kit: Shelving for pre-packed stock by best-before date
Hampers and pre-packed gift boxes.power_detail: A label printer and laptop on standard sockets.
Hampers and pre-packed gift boxes.safety: Pre-packed foods stay sealed in their packaging, so there is no open food handling. You usually still need to register as a food business. Rotate stock by best-before date, and only include alcohol if you have the right licence.
Hampers and pre-packed gift boxes.racking: Pre-packed food on shelving, oldest dates at the front, baskets stacked high, fill and ribbon in boxes.
Hampers and pre-packed gift boxes.benches: Folding or wheeled tables become an assembly line in the run-up to Christmas and fold away in quiet months.
Hampers and pre-packed gift boxes.flow: Stock arrives through the shutter and is shelved by date. Hampers are assembled on the table, wrapped, and stacked by the door for delivery.
Hampers and pre-packed gift boxes.cover: Products liability, stock cover and goods in transit if you deliver are worth raising with a broker.

Dried flower studio.answer: Dried flower bouquets, wreaths and arrangements need hanging space and a workbench, which fit in a 150 or 160 sq ft unit.
kit: Hanging rails or freestanding drying racks
Dried flower studio.power_detail: Lighting and a dehumidifier on standard sockets, if needed.
Dried flower studio.safety: Dried flowers are dry, low-risk material, but they catch light easily, so keep them well away from heaters and lamps. Dried flowers are not food, so food rules do not apply unless you add edible items.
Dried flower studio.racking: Stems on shelving by type and colour, bunches hung on rails, and finished arrangements boxed on upper shelves.
Dried flower studio.benches: A wheeled work table lets you switch between making wreaths and packing orders.
Dried flower studio.flow: Stems come in, are sorted and stored, arranged on the bench, then boxed and stored by the door for dispatch or collection.
Dried flower studio.cover: Stock cover and public liability for clients and markets are the covers to discuss with a broker.

unit-ideas-market-traders.power_note: Lights and a card reader charger
unit-ideas-market-traders.layout_note: Stock shelves and a loading area
